request.rationale: Select both left- and right-seeded KCg-d five-contact operational groups before any selection-language loss. They retain every literal KCg-d seed on its selected side, include annotated partners, and provide two complete within-size comparisons at 487 and 540 neurons. Their visual-KC motivation comes from the prior pathway audit; neither is an intact circuit. Both are the lowest-cost complete group pair in the measured catalog. Three thousand shared updates permit a first controlled selection and topology screen across all 128 fits within a 72-hour training planning allowance, instead of selecting individual favorable controls. The shorter exposure limits claims about convergence and must not be compared as an equal-budget replacement for the 12000-update BabyLM baselines. Further exposure, olfactory-seeded groups and one-contact sensitivity remain later registered studies.

validation_panel_binding.selection: Existing score-independent BabyLM panel: eight hashed-ID blocks per component

manifest.boundary_semantics: Artificial whole-line blocks within a component file; true document and speaker boundaries unknown.
manifest.roundtrip: Every block reconstructs its exact source bytes; every source byte is retained once.

cost.limitation: Only original graphs were timed, at seed 42. Rewires and seed 43 use original-graph cost proxies. Loading, validation, checkpoint I/O and long-run effects are unmeasured; the allowance is a planning assumption, not a wall-time guarantee.

selection: Earliest exact minimum validation BPB over every declared checkpoint

evaluation_policy.state: Reset at each block; carry across chunks within that block
evaluation_policy.selection_comparisons: Candidate minus ranked, mean of three uniform selections, and mean of three stratified selections; also retain all seven individual contrasts
evaluation_policy.topology_comparisons: Measured minus mean of three rewires for every selector; also retain all 24 individual contrasts
evaluation_policy.averaging: Arithmetic mean of per-block negative log likelihoods, not a probability ensemble
evaluation_policy.uncertainty: Paired blocks within source, conditional on each training seed and the selected graphs/checkpoints; unadjusted descriptive intervals. Do not count rewires or node selections as independent training replications.

test_policy: Require every registered condition complete and selected before any held-out token access; use the source-bound inference and comparison policy
scope: Selection methods differ in edge/parameter counts; within-subset rewires control topology at fixed allocation. Operational truncated candidates, not intact functional circuits or animal behavior.

execution_amendment.cohort: All 128 fresh CPU fits on the declared Mac runtime; no Windows checkpoints included
execution_amendment.historical_pilot: Original Windows pilot retained unchanged as historical evidence; its timings and initial tensors are not Mac measurements
